allow: PowerShell(npm run lint; Write-Output "---LINT EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---"; npm test; Write-Output "---TEST EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---"; node build.cjs; Write-Output "---BUILD EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---")
PowerShell(npm install --save-dev @eslint/js@latest eslint@latest globals@latest typescript@latest esbuild@latest; Write-Output "---INSTALL EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---")
PowerShell(npm run lint; Write-Output "---LINT EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---"; npx tsc -p jsconfig.json --noEmit; Write-Output "---TSC EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---")
PowerShell(npx tsc -p jsconfig.json --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern '^src/' | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '_deprecated' }; Write-Output "---ACTIVE SRC TSC DONE---")

PowerShell(npm run lint; Write-Output "---LINT EXIT $LASTEXITCODE---"; node --test --env-file=.env.testing --experimental-test-module-mocks test/ 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern '# \(pass|fail|skip\)|failing tests|✖'; Write-Output "---TEST DONE---")
